tool_args.rationale: The irregular, history-conditioned rows and pilot signatures support the coupled memory ODE, but five observations do not identify its four parameters reliably. Acquire the indicated fine trajectory batch to reach the stated minimum before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled two-state memory ODE from the five existing trajectories
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: There are four coupled parameters and history-derived initial memory states; the provided mechanism guidance explicitly requires at least eight rows for identification.
It does not supply the additional trajectories required to identify the indicated ODE parameters.
Irrelevant to the target law and unnecessarily costly.
